name: klntrain-monorepo
description: Chạy toàn bộ hệ thống KLN Train (backend + portal khách hàng + portal điều phối + portal quản trị)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,USER,DIEUPHOI,ADMIN -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:dieuphoi" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix DuAnTauHoaCom/backend install && npm --prefix DuAnTauHoaCom/frontend install && npm --prefix DuAnTauHoaCom/DieuPhoiVien/frontend install && npm --prefix train install
